card.name: Word just before a qualifying clause or note
card.fires_on: Words that sit right before a qualifying statement: "weighing" after "patients" in weight-based dosing, and the colon or following words after "Note" or "Please note". Also fires on a few scattered words inside table footnotes.

modes.label: After Note
modes.description: The colon, or words just after it, following "Note" or "Please note" in web text.

modes.label: Table footnote terms
modes.description: Words inside drug-table footnotes, such as "resistance" after a drug name.
